primary_endpoint: Proportion with NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis at Week 52.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 52, NASH resolution rates were 16.7% with placebo, 37.5% with BFKB8488A 50 mg, 14.3% with 75 mg, and 33.3% with 100 mg; no statistical comparisons were reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 0/13 placebo participants, 1/11 in the 50 mg group, 1/11 in the 75 mg group, and 0/11 in the 100 mg group; no deaths were reported.
